newsitem.title: USA: Atlanta group seeks to block stadium demolition.
newsitem.headline: Atlanta group seeks to block stadium demolition.

text.p: A Georgia civic group said Tuesday it had filed suit seeking to halt demolition of the Atlanta Fulton County Stadium.

The suit filed by the nonprofit group, Save Our Stadium Inc, challenges the legality of a 1993 agreement that calls for the stadium to be razed and the underlying land leased to the Atlanta Braves for parking once the team begins playing at the new Turner Field stadium next door.

SOS said the 20-year lease agreement was illegal because it conveyed publicly owned property to a private corporation without a public hearing or a vote by the City Council or the Fulton County Commission.

The suit was filed Friday in Fulton County Superior Court against the City of Atlanta, Fulton County, the Atlanta Fulton County Recreation Authority and the Atlanta Braves. It seeks an expedited hearing.
The plaintiffs' group was formed last year to determine whether the old stadium could be converted to a new public use.

Atlanta Mayor Bill Campbell was not immediately available for comment, but his spokesman told the Atlanta Journal-Constitution that the mayor believes the four-year-old lease agreement should be honored. The Braves are scheduld to assume the lease on April 4.
